mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Prepare an ABAP profiler (SAT) trace so the next run is measured.

description: [read-only] Schedules an ABAP profiler trace in one request. Optional: description, profiling flags (all_procedural_units, all_misc_abap_statements, all_internal_table_events, all_dynpro_events, aggregate, explicit_on_off, with_rfc_tracing, all_system_kernel_events, sql_trace, all_db_events, max_size_for_trace_file, amdp_trace, max_time_for_tracing). Response: JSON { success, profiler_id }, profiler_id the id of the scheduled trace. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.
name: HandlerProfileSchedule
